issue.title: 期間フィルターをカレンダーの日付範囲選択へ変更

summary: Replace preset-only period selection with an accessible timezone-aware calendar range shared by all data consumers.
decisions: Use inclusive start/end calendar dates interpreted in the selected ad account timezone.
Presets may remain as shortcuts but the serialized contract is explicit startDate/endDate.
Invalid, reversed, future-only, or excessive ranges fail predictably.

risks.description: Browser UTC conversion may shift an account date.
risks.mitigation: Serialize date-only values and interpret them in the account timezone server-side.

risks.description: Dashboard, Agent, and report may calculate different windows.
risks.mitigation: Centralize validation/comparison derivation and contract-test every consumer.

acceptanceCriteria: Users can choose and clear an inclusive date range by pointer and keyboard.
The UI names the account timezone and persists date-only start/end values.
Dashboard, Agent, and report receive the same validated range and comparison period.
Reversed, malformed, future-only, and over-limit ranges have explicit errors.
Preset shortcuts produce the same contract as manual selection.

rollback.strategy: Return the UI to validated presets while keeping server date-range validation backward compatible.
rollback.verification: Preset windows match the previous KPI queries and do not shift account dates.
